source: CardInsider extraction pipeline (v3.1.1 baseline) + redemption_rules transform v1
_note: Fuel exclusions were recorded as exclusion_type 'other', which _isExcluded never reads, so cards that earn nothing at a petrol pump were still ranked there on their base rate — a user reported BPCL showing the wrong cards, with a card that excludes fuel sitting top at 15%. Retyped 58 of them to 'category'/'fuel'. Qualified wordings (excluded from an accelerator, from EMI conversion, or carrying a carve-out) were deliberately left alone.
